profile.name: Rindi Tri Setyaningsih
profile.headline: GIS & Data Analyst
profile.intro: GIS and Data Analyst with a background in Geographic Information Systems, specializing in geospatial analysis, spatial data, data visualization, and web-based mapping. I enjoy transforming complex data into clear insights and practical solutions.
profile.about:
I am a Geographic Information Systems graduate from Universitas Gadjah Mada with an interest in data analytics, geospatial analysis, data visualization, and web GIS development. My background combines spatial thinking with programming and data-driven problem solving.

I work with geospatial and structured data to support analysis, visualization, and decision-making. Through academic projects, internships, and community-based projects, I have gained experience working with GIS, spatial databases, remote sensing, web mapping, and data visualization.

projects.title: SIPTALA — Landslide Reporting WebGIS
projects.description: A WebGIS system for landslide reporting and identification of landslide-prone areas in Karanganyar. The system integrates spatial data, web mapping, and reporting features to support landslide monitoring and information management.

projects.title: RITAMAP — Dashboard RUPTL PT PLN Persero
projects.description: A geospatial mapping project developed during my experience at PLN UIP JBT, focusing on spatial data processing, visualization, and mapping to support operational information and geospatial data management.

projects.title: Sleman Foodie — Culinary WebGIS
projects.description: A WebGIS platform for exploring culinary destinations in Sleman, Yogyakarta through an interactive map-based interface. The project integrates spatial data, database management, and interactive web mapping to present location-based culinary information.

projects.title: Yogyakarta Sea Wonderland — Coastal Tourism WebGIS
projects.description: A WebGIS platform for exploring coastal tourism destinations in Gunungkidul, Yogyakarta. The project combines spatial data, interactive web mapping, and tourism information to create an accessible location-based tourism platform.

projects.title: Python-Based LiDAR Point Cloud Analysis & 3D Geospatial Modeling
projects.description: A comprehensive LiDAR point cloud analysis project combining Python, 3D geospatial processing, and machine learning. The workflow covers Drone–SLAM co-registration using Point-to-Plane ICP, point cloud classification with Random Forest, ground filtering with CSF, DSM and DTM generation, and tree volume estimation using DBSCAN clustering and voxel-based modeling.

projects.title: Advanced Geospatial Data Science
projects.description: A collection of advanced geospatial data science projects covering unstructured data processing, geovisualization, remote sensing, terrain analysis, machine learning, and deep learning. The projects include object detection, semantic and instance segmentation, DEM analysis, spectral indices, and forest and land fire probability mapping.

projects.title: Coastal & Marine Geospatial Analysis
projects.description: A collection of coastal and marine geospatial analysis projects covering benthic habitat classification, bathymetry, chlorophyll-a concentration, pelagic fish catch potential, sea surface temperature, salinity, wave formation, subsurface currents, and wave-current interactions.

projects.title: Water Resources & Groundwater Analysis
projects.description: A collection of geospatial analysis projects focused on water resources and groundwater, including watershed delineation, terrain analysis, river order classification, rainfall interpolation, water turbidity mapping, groundwater interpolation, groundwater flow direction, and groundwater depth accuracy assessment.

projects.title: Customer Behavior Dashboard — Power BI
projects.description: An interactive Power BI dashboard designed to analyze customer purchasing behavior, subscription status, demographics, product categories, revenue, shipping preferences, and customer review ratings. The dashboard provides an overview of customer segments and sales patterns to support data-driven business insights.

projects.title: HR Attrition Analysis Dashboard — Power BI
projects.description: An interactive HR analytics dashboard developed in Power BI to analyze employee attrition patterns. The dashboard explores attrition rates across departments and job roles, along with employee demographics, monthly income, tenure, overtime, and other workforce characteristics to identify potential factors associated with employee turnover.
